summary: The diff shows extensive removal of authentication logic across frontend and backend. However, the backend (main.mo) still retains significant authentication-related code including access control mixins, user approval logic, and authentication-gated endpoints. Frontend changes appear complete with authentication components disabled/stubbed and hooks modified to bypass authentication. A migration module was added to handle state transitions.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove access control, user approval, and authentication mixins from backend/main.mo and disable all authentication checks in backend endpoints
missing_requirements.reason: Backend main.mo still includes AccessControl and MixinAuthorization imports and initialization, includes UserApproval state and methods (isCallerApproved, requestApproval, setApproval, listApprovals), and retains authentication checks like 'if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #admin)))' that trap unauthorized access

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove UserProfile data type and all user management endpoints from backend/main.mo including approval, profile, and admin check methods
missing_requirements.reason: Backend main.mo still contains approval-related methods (isCallerApproved, requestApproval, setApproval, listApprovals) that should be removed according to the requirement

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module added to handle state transitions from old actor structure to new
hallucinated_features.reason: Migration module (backend/migration.mo) was not requested in any requirement. The BuildRequest only asks for removal of authentication logic, not adding migration infrastructure

hallucinated_features.description: Access Management page implementation as a stub/disabled component
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-4 states 'Access Management page is removed or accessible to all' but the diff shows a new AccessManagementPage.tsx was created showing a disabled message. The requirement could be satisfied by removal (not creating a stub page) or making it accessible without restrictions
